notes.title: 11月20日更新说明（November 20th Update Notes）
notes.notes:
[b]中文[/b]
1. 修复动物繁殖期状态无法触发任务的问题。  
2. 上调后期任务的资源奖励数量。

[b]English[/b]
1. Fix the issue where the animal breeding period status fails to trigger tasks.  
2. Increase the resource rewards for late-game tasks.

notes.title: 1.0.2版本更新（Version 1.0.2 Update）
notes.notes:
[b]中文：[/b]
1、修复了农民无法收割与储水池相邻地块成熟作物的问题。
2、修复了通过其他工具收获成熟植物时，未触发储水池相邻地块浇水的问题。
3、下调了困难模式中的游戏难度。

[b]English[/b]
1、Fixed the issue where farmers could not harvest crops when the farmland was adjacent to a water reservoir.
2、Fixed the issue where mature plants harvested using other tools did not trigger watering for farmland 
3、adjacent to a water reservoir.
Reduced the game difficulty in hard mode.

notes.title: 11月16更新说明（November 16 Update Notes）
notes.notes:
1、优化钓鱼系统体验，增加判定范围，将钓鱼时长从3秒延长至4秒。
Optimize the fishing system experience by increasing the detection range and extending the fishing duration from 3 seconds to 4 seconds.
